user.title: Select meter model
user.description: Choose the meter model to connect, then configure the connection details in the next step.

connection.title: Connection details
connection.description: Connect to the meter via Modbus TCP (optionally through an RTU-to-TCP serial server). Communication must be enabled on the meter.

data.name: Connection name (defaults to the meter model; rename to distinguish multiple meters, duplicate names get the slave address appended)
data.host: Meter or serial server IP address

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Confirm the meter model, then modify the connection details in the next step.

reconfigure_connection.title: Modify connection details
reconfigure_connection.description: Adjust the connection information, the entry reloads automatically after saving.

data.name: Connection name (defaults to the meter model; rename to distinguish multiple meters, duplicate names get the slave address appended)
data.host: Meter or serial server IP address

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the meter. Check the IP, port and slave address.

init.title: Runtime settings
init.description: Adjust the polling interval, takes effect immediately after saving.
